data_cdn_meta.name: schemas/manifest-v60/action.schema.json
data_cdn_meta.description: Per-role schema for manifests/<saas>/actions/<verb>.yaml body (post-_meta-strip). Requires description + flavors; object / commits_changes / depends_on_view / inputs / result are optional. Per-flavor recipe shape validated permissively here; runtime validator enforces step-type vocabulary.
data_cdn_meta.regenerate_requires: spec 60.3 §D3.5 — TS source-of-truth generator path; currently hand-rolled for v0

title: Spec 60 — actions/<verb>.yaml body
description: Validates the body of a per-SaaS action recipe file (e.g. manifests/gmail/actions/send_email.yaml) after _meta is stripped. description + flavors required.

object.description: Entity name this action operates on (e.g. Message, Thread).

commits_changes.description: Whether this action mutates server-side state. Drives commit-confirmation UX.

depends_on_view.description: View the user must be in before this action can run (e.g. ComposePanel for send_email).

flavors.description: Map of flavor id (dom_no_submit, dom_submit, api, …) → flavor definition (recipe + outcomes). At least one flavor required.
